count_distribution.day1_ladder_caveat: A17-08: MODEL OUTPUT, not a base rate. In the feed's own record 0 of 6 print windows around a day-1 <= -5% print ever reached 3 downgrades, and both >=3 windows followed SMALL day-1 moves (Feb 2022 +3.6%, Nov 2023 -3.3%). The bucket language is the signal, not the tape.

estimates.conventions: downgrade = feed row Action==down with ToGrade Hold- or Sell-equivalent, 17 Sep-15 Dec 2026, one per firm per day; initiations, reiterations, target-only cuts and down-moves to a Buy grade do not count; [A17-07, revised] an action the feed does not carry does not count, whoever the firm - Phillip Securities HAS a feed row (12 Nov 2024) and would count on a new one, but its 11 Aug 2026 action never appeared; Weiss has no feed row at all

model.structure: S02 REVISION-2 branches (0.32/0.10/0.13/0.45; day-1 means +4/-1/-2.5/-6 with within-branch sd 8.451 from the variance identity; post drifts -1.5/-0.5/-0.5/-1.0 over 26 sessions; 36 pre sessions, 30% vol, 6.97% drift) -> pre-print NB(0.26 x exp(-3 x min(p1,0)) / E[.]) + post-print NB(branch mean 0.085/0.525/0.625/0.965 x exp(-0.06 x day-1 surprise) x exp(-3 x min(r_post,0)) / E[.]), overdispersion 1.6, feed capture 0.85; Yes if count >= 3

recentring.note: A17-04: each mean is divided by its simulated E[modulation] so the unconditional mean equals a named base rate by construction and the modulations only redistribute across branches
